places: Unification Day (unification of Romania and Transylvania)

fields.climate: temperate; cold, cloudy winters with frequent snow and fog; sunny summers with frequent showers and thunderstorms
fields.terrain: central Transylvanian Basin is separated from the Moldavian Plateau on the east by the Eastern Carpathian Mountains and separated from the Walachian Plain on the south by the Transylvanian Alps
fields.hazards: earthquakes, most severe in south and southwest; geologic structure and climate promote landslides
fields.resources: petroleum (reserves declining), timber, natural gas, coal, iron ore, salt, arable land, hydropower
fields.farm: wheat, maize, milk, sunflower seeds, barley, rapeseed, potatoes, grapes, plums, apples
fields.exports: cars, vehicle parts/accessories, insulated wire, garments, wheat
fields.industries: electric machinery and equipment, auto assembly, textiles and footwear, light machinery, metallurgy, chemicals, food processing, petroleum refining, mining, timber, construction materials
fields.religions: Romanian Orthodox 85.3%, Roman Catholic 4.5%, Reformed 3%, Pentecostal 2.5%, other 4.7%

holiday.name: Unification Day (unification of Romania and Transylvania)

fields.military: typically 18-35 years of age for voluntary service for men and women; compulsory service ended in 2007
